subject.title: fix(kill-tree): verify process group leader before using group kill to prevent gateway SIGTERM (#76259)

question: Should OpenClaw accept the helper-side process-group leader check as the compatibility fix for omitted-detached Unix cleanup after this branch is refreshed against main?
rationale: The code fix matches the reported bug, but it deliberately changes a process-cleanup default and green tests cannot cover every managed gateway, PTY, and minimal-Linux environment.

options.title: Refresh and accept this fix
options.body: Resolve the current conflict, preserve the leader-check plus detached-caller audit, and land after focused process cleanup tests and required CI pass.

options.title: Require stricter opt-in group kill
options.body: Ask for a narrower API/default direction where group kill is only used for explicit caller-proven detachment.

options.title: Wait for more live gateway proof
options.body: Pause until a maintainer reruns the affected managed-gateway scenario on current head.

recommendation.title: Refresh and accept this fix
recommendation.body: Resolve the current conflict, preserve the leader-check plus detached-caller audit, and land after focused process cleanup tests and required CI pass.

likelyOwner.reason: This account approved and merged the prior related process-tree fix, so it is the best available history-backed owner for the compatibility choice.
